body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and move it 1 unit sideways. After resolving, you and one adjacent willing ally may each move 1 unit around it.

surges.html: The moved creatures ignore the target's movement Reactions for this movement.

rider.title: Authority - Formation
rider.html: Spend this Authority when you or the ally next attacks the target from a different space before your next turn: ignore 1 point of its equipment Fortitude for that attack.
